briefing: British 11th and Guards Armoured Divisions encounter remnants of German 1st SS and 21st Panzer Divisions. Formations and date as printed, not independently verified historical strengths.
victory: Allied victory: control every town hex and bridge hex on A at game end, with Allied units eliminated divided by German units eliminated strictly less than 3:2.
German victory: prevent Allied victory. Zero-denominator handling remains unresolved.
specialRules: Use US M4/75 and M4/76 counters to fill British Shermans, using British values; use M3 halftracks to fill Bren counters. Digital setup supplies the full matching British roster. No more than five aircraft on the map at any time.

boards.display: Source-sheet orientation with 346 addressable hex fragments; first-pass terrain and LOS symbols, not admitted terrain. Boundary fragments remain separate until assembly aliases are resolved.

deployment.evidence: Printed setup applied to card-oriented source coordinates. Boundary fragments, water and stream hexes excluded as applicable. Goodwood stream half-planes and armored classification require rules review before combat admission.

objectives: Allied victory: control every town hex and bridge hex on A at game end, with Allied units eliminated divided by German units eliminated strictly less than 3:2.
German victory: prevent Allied victory. Zero-denominator handling remains unresolved.
sourceRules.specialRules: Use US M4/75 and M4/76 counters to fill British Shermans, using British values; use M3 halftracks to fill Bren counters. Digital setup supplies the full matching British roster. No more than five aircraft on the map at any time.
sourceRules.execution: Setup and game-map inspection only. Combat, movement, air operations, exit scoring and victory adjudication are not implemented.

airSupport.instructions: Eight rocket-armed Typhoons; no additional card entry delay. No more than five aircraft may be on the map at once. This is an aircraft-count cap, not a flight-count cap.
